retrievalProfile.description: A high-energy 1980s commercial layout featuring stacked chrome 3D lettering over a deep blue airbrushed gradient with a grid of artist portraits.

recipe.visualDefinition: A complex multi-layered composition dominated by a large, central 3D gold-chrome title block that recedes into the distance, set against a dark blue radial gradient background. The bottom third features a horizontal row of framed photographic portraits, while the top contains vibrant neon-colored geometric sans-serif titles and diagonal promotional stickers.
coreVisualRelationships: Stacked hierarchy with the largest 3D element in the center
Contrast between deep blue background and bright gold/neon foreground elements
Rhythmic repetition of square-framed portraits at the base
Diagonal tension created by a tilted rectangular badge in the upper right
coreInvariants: 3D gold chrome texture on main title

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The central 3D title occupies the middle 50% of the vertical space; a large numeral '1' sits directly above it as a secondary anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The massive 3D 'HITS' text in gold chrome.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top neon title, drop to the central gold 3D block, then scan the row of portraits from left to right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep blue space concentrated in the upper corners and between the central text and the bottom grid.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-value, high-saturation accents against a low-value, moody background.

letterConstructionRules: Main title uses extreme 3D extrusion with a vanishing point behind the text
Top title features interlocking 'O' characters and thin, uniform stroke weights
Secondary text is clean, high-legibility sans-serif with wide tracking
characterSpecificRedesigns: Interlocking circles in the top title to create a chain-link effect
Beveled edges on the 3D gold letters to catch 'specular highlights'
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme 3D metallic display text paired with flat, vibrant geometric sans-serifs for a high-tech retro feel.
graphicDevices: Diagonal 'burst' or 'sticker' badge in the upper right
Thin white horizontal rules separating sections

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the geometric foundation for the 80s look.
Captures the square-ish, technological feel of the era.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a deep navy blue airbrushed radial gradient background. Place a row of five equally spaced square photographic portraits at the bottom, each with a thin white border. Add a gold circular emblem in the top left and a tilted magenta rectangle in the top right.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large 3D gold-chrome title in the center with extreme perspective receding upwards. Add neon magenta and cyan geometric text at the top, ensuring the 'O' characters interlock. Place clean white sans-serif metadata text between the central title and the portraits.

verificationChecks: Is the central text 3D with a gold chrome finish?
Are there five distinct portrait frames at the bottom?
Is the background a smooth blue gradient?
Are the top titles in neon magenta and cyan?

postGenerationChecks: Check for specular highlights on the gold text.
Ensure the diagonal badge is tilted at approximately 20 degrees.
Verify the white borders on portraits are consistent.
Confirm the blue gradient is darkest at the edges.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [3D Chrome Title] + [Airbrushed Blue Gradient] + [Neon Geometric Header] + [Bottom Portrait Grid] to recreate the 80s compilation aesthetic.
